title: Can I use your account for one day?
scenario: A friend says they were unfairly banned from a social app and asks to use your account for one day to keep a streak and message their group. They promise not to change anything.

answers.A: Do not share the account; help them appeal or communicate through another safe channel.
answers.B: Offer to send one message on their behalf without giving them login access.
answers.C: Let them use it while you stay nearby and watch what they do.

explanation: Even trusted friends can trigger bans, expose private messages or accidentally change recovery settings.
proTip: If the account represents you, keep control of it.
